rubric.evidence: Verified on 2026-11-27 against MDN Clipboard/read, ClipboardItem/getType, and ClipboardItem/types (all direct HTTP 200 with Specifications and Browser compatibility): because Selective Clipboard Format Read is an internal lazy-fetch optimization with zero API surface change, deferring API reference to MDN while summarizing Chrome 149's deferred getType() fetch, caching, stale-clipboard rejection, and MSEdgeExplainers benchmark is accurate and honest.
